manifest.title: The chamber's imprint at every frequency, and how long a room rings

finding: In these models no response peaks narrowly: no case shows a peak standing 20% above its surroundings between 6 and 240 Hz. Under a surface wave the imprint's largest value is 0.163 of the motion, at 79 Hz (its band cut by the model's upper limit); 1.980 for the room under a 5 m roof (its band cut by the model's upper limit); 0.043 for the bench room 30 m down. Waves from below: 0.306 (P, envelope width ratio 1.4) and 0.344 (S, its band cut by the model's upper limit). Rung on its ceiling and recorded for 4 s, the largest modal Q resolved is 2.2 and the energy falls 60 dB within 13.34 s; over 4 s of a passing surface wave, 0.01% of the imprint's energy at the ground comes after the wave has passed. At the low end the imprint approaches P2-04's static answer (0.96 to 1.82 of it between 6 and 12 Hz). Halving the grid changes the imprint by at most 6% below 120 Hz (11% for the thin roof).
